articles.title: Ex-FCA policy insider explains the ‘great divide’ in the UK’s crypto ambition
articles.summary: Former FCA policymaker and Hedera Global Policy VP, Isadora Arredondo says there is a gap between the U.K.'s crypto ambitions and how policy is carried out in practice.
